Error Text.SourceString: Error: Command "{command}" not recognized. Please enter a valid command. Or type "{help}" for a list of available commands.

Help Text.SourceString:
Available Commands:

1. help - Display available commands and their descriptions.
2. clear - Clear the terminal screen.
3. scan - Scan for available world actors with the Hiraeth Terminal interface.
4. disconnect - Log out from the terminal user (works only if authentication is required).
5. cd <directory> - Change directory to navigate within the terminal system.
6. <custom command> - Execute a custom command. (Replace <custom command> with your specific command.)

7- Activate <id>- Activate target actor.
8- Deactivate <id> - Deactivate target actor.
9- Lock <id> - Lock target actor.
10- Download <file_id> - Download content from target file.
